messages:
Ava (People Ops): Morning folks  launching a short 'fastlane' for SOC2/ISO evidence this cycle. If your team owns <10 controls you can opt into fastlane: condensed checklist + one consolidated upload. Opt-in form: https://confluence.redwood.ai/compliance/fastlane. Deadline to opt in: Fri Jun 11 COB.

Rajat (Eng): What's the tradeoff vs standard intake? Do auditors still sample the same?

Ken (Security): Fastlane means tighter prescriptive artifacts per control. Auditors will still sample but we aim to make sampling deterministic (fewer follow-ups). You'll need runbook link, access list, and 60-day logs per control unless control says otherwise.

Marta (Legal): A couple of legal points: 1) contractors must be included unless your team has a signed vendor exclusion; 2) if your consolidated upload contains customer data, apply the redaction checklist and add a short metadata note.

Ava (People Ops): Ops flow: nominate a single fastlane lead, complete the condensed checklist, upload one zip to the intake page. We'll run an automated pre-check and flag missing items. Office hours Thursday 11:00 PT and Friday 14:00 PT.

compliance-bot: Opt-in form posted. Auto-check scheduled after upload to verify filenames and required fields. Processing time ~3-7 minutes.

Rajat (Eng): Can the lead be an IC? Our manager is OOO next week.

Ava (People Ops): Yes, ICs can be leads but manager approval must follow in the tracker within 48h. If manager is OOO, use the backup-approval field in the form.

Ken (Security): Filename guidance: use team-controlID-fastlane-YYYYMMDD.zip, e.g., billing-C03-fastlane-20260610.zip. Also include a manifest.txt listing files and redaction status.

Rajat (Eng): Noted. We'll review internals and opt-in. Quick q: does fastlane require the manager attestation checkbox too?

Marta (Legal): Yes managers still attest. Fastlane only reduces artifact counts, not attestations.

Ava (People Ops): Thanks everyone. Please opt in early if you can. We'll publish the fastlane roster and an FAQ on the page by EOD. Ping me if you want a 15-min walkthrough. :sparkles:

Rajat (Eng): Opted in and nominated Priya as lead. Uploaded initial manifest for review.

compliance-bot: Intake pre-check completed  one missing log file flagged. See intake page for details.

Ava (People Ops): Quick follow-up: flagged issues must be fixed within 48h to count as fastlane. If not fixed, your team will be moved back to standard intake.

Ken (Security): Small tip: when exporting logs, include timezone and generation timestamp in the header. Saves back-and-forth with auditors.

Ava (People Ops): Great work team  I'll send a summary email to directors after opt-in closes.
